_comment: What each coach operator says about travelling with a wheelchair: in its own terms, from its own pages, each with the page and the date it was checked. Shown under a stop's access details where coaches call, and in the Bus tab for a coach (app.js). Checked 6 November 2026 at the maintainer's request (accessibility information front and centre). buses: what the law requires of every full-size local bus, cited to the Department for Transport's guidance on each set of regulations; shown in the Bus tab for a local bus, as the law's requirement, not a check of that bus.

NATX.name: National Express
NATX.summary: Every coach has a wheelchair lift at the front door. Booking is advised but not essential; if you will move from your wheelchair to a coach seat, book at least 36 hours ahead.
NATX.contact: Assisted Travel Team: 03717 81 81 81, 8am to 6pm, every day

FLIX.name: FlixBus
FLIX.summary: Wheelchairs and walking aids travel free. FlixBus recommends its contact form at least 36 hours before departure to be sure of space; you may still travel without it, but the space may be taken.

buses.wheelchair: The law has required every full-size local bus to be wheelchair accessible since 1 January 2017 (single-deck buses since 1 January 2016), under the Public Service Vehicles Accessibility Regulations 2000.
buses.announcements: Every upcoming stop must be announced, heard and shown, on local buses in stages under the Public Service Vehicles (Accessible Information) Regulations 2023: from 1 October 2024 for buses first used from October 2019, 1 October 2025 for those first used from October 2014, and 1 October 2026 for older ones. Partly compliant buses have until 1 October 2031.
